==Use==
<pre>
name=Tree article link
alt=Alternate label of link
super=superscript next to name (optional)
color=tile color
decid=Yes/No (not included=No)
biome=Biome Name (see Biome tokens)
biome2=,biome3=,biome4=,...,biome9= (for multiple biomes)
dry=wet/dry (y=dry, n=wet, b=both, not included=none)
align=Good/Evil/Savage (not included if All)
tile1={{tile||0:0}} tree part (if this is not included, it will display the default tree parts as shown above)
tile2=,tile3=,tile4,...,tile9=
dense=wood density
drink=Tree fruit alcohol (optional)
drinkv=drink value×5 (optional)
eat=eat raw (y=yes, not included=no)
cook=eat cooked (y=yes, p=processed, not included=no)
grow1={{tile||0:0:0}} growth 1
grow2=,grow3,grow4,...grow9=
graphic=trunk graphic
sapling=sapling graphic

Example:

{{multi-tile tree table head}}
{{multi-tile tree table row|name=Oak|super=5|symbol=♠|color=2:0|decid=Yes|biome=Any Temperate Broadleaf|dry=y|dense=0.700
  |eat=y|cook=y
  |grow1={{tile|♠|2:0}}{{tile|♠|6:1}}{{tile|♠|4:1}}{{tile|♠|4:0}} leaf
  |grow2={{tile|♣|2:0}} flower
  |grow3={{tile|•|6:0}} acorn
  }}
{{multi-tile tree table row|name=Tower-cap|symbol=♠|color=7:1|decid=No|biome=Wet Cavern/Layers 1-2|dry=b|dense=0.600
  |tile1={{tile|O|7:1}} trunk
  |tile2={{tile|O|7:1}}{{tile|║|7:1}}{{tile|▲|7:1}}{{tile|∙|7:1}} cap
  |eat=n|cook=n
  }}
{{multi-tile tree table row|name=Glumprong|symbol=┤|color=5:0|decid=No|biome=Not Freezing|dry=y|align=Evil|dense=1.200
  |tile1={{tile|O|5:0}}{{tile|═|5:0}}{{tile|⌂|5:0}} trunk
  |tile2={{tile|¼|5:0}} roots
  |eat=n|cook=n
  }}
{{multi-tile tree table row|name=Banana|alt=Plantain|super=3|symbol=Γ|color=2:0|decid=No|biome=Any Tropical|dry=y|dense=0.600
  |tile1={{tile|O|2:0}}{{tile|⌂|2:0}} trunk
  |tile2={{tile|¼|6:0}} roots
  |drink=Banana beer|drinkv=10|eat=y|cook=y
  |grow1={{tile|♠|2:0}} leaf
  |grow2={{tile|♣|4:0}} flower
  |grow3={{tile|%|6:1}} fruit
  }}
|}
